metadata.backend_validation: Each Lambda lane must emit a fresh finalized MIR artifact during its untimed warmup. AST/AUTO and MIR interpreter selection are disabled.
metadata.boundaries: MVP measures its generated program entry; other engines use the original benchmark timers. Startup, parsing, compilation, printing and teardown are excluded. Node tiering during execution is included.
metadata.order: one warmup per engine, then rotating engine order each round
metadata.lambda_scope: Unannotated canonical ports; normal Lambda numeric semantics. Collatz uses shr where JS divides by two. These are port comparisons.

mir_audit.definition: Finalized pre-JIT MIR; instructions exclude declarations and labels and include cold/error paths. Counts are static, not executed instructions.
